description: List the brand's Deep AI Dive probe topics (offerings the AI engines are asked about). Free, read-only; never derives new topics. Returns topics[] (id, label, description, selected) — `selected` means the topic is in the saved config and WILL be asked in the next run — plus questionsPerTopic, runs and marketKeys. Custom topics have ids starting 'custom-'. Also returns `inProgress` (a probe run or topic drafting is running right now) and `lastError` (a failed drafting/run reason, if any). Use the ids with ai_visibility_topic_include / ai_visibility_topic_remove. Topics added with ai_visibility_topic_add show selected=false until ai_visibility_topic_include has drafted their questions; after calling it, poll this tool until they flip to selected=true.
name: ai_visibility_topics_list
